articles.title: Earth's Magnetic Field Could Be a Giant Dark Matter Detector
articles.summary: Scientists used Earth's magnetic field to hunt for dark matter. They found some weird signals that might be dark matter, but they're not sure yet. It's like using the whole planet as a giant ear!

articles.title: Wildfires Can Be Tracked by Their Low Rumble
articles.summary: Scientists used special microphones to listen to a wildfire's low rumble. They could track where it spread, even when they couldn't see it. This could help spot fires early!

articles.title: SpaceX Launches 27 More Starlink Satellites, Rocket Lands on Ship
articles.summary: SpaceX sent 27 Starlink satellites into space today. The rocket's first stage landed on a drone ship in the Pacific. It's the 103rd Falcon 9 launch this year!
